title: SEADIALOGUES: A Multilingual Culturally Grounded Multi-turn Dialogue Dataset on Southeast Asian Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a dataset to improve cultural grounding in dialogue systems across Southeast Asian languages. While it includes subtopics like 'spirituality', 'Buddhist-belief', and 'comparing the morals behind folk tales', these are included as part of a broad cultural context. The paper's core objective and benchmarking metrics (Fluency, Coherence, etc.) are focused on conversational quality and cultural relevance rather than a dedicated assessment of religion, morals, or ethics.
